The '''2011–12 Copa del Rey''' was the 110th staging of the [[Copa del Rey]] (including two seasons where two rival editions were played). The competition began on 31 August 2011 and ended on 25 May 2012 with the [[2012 Copa del Rey Final|final]], which was held at the [[Vicente Calderón Stadium]] in [[Madrid]]. Entering the competition, the winners were assured of a place in the [[2012–13 UEFA Europa League#Group stage|group stage]] of the [[2012–13 UEFA Europa League]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Europa League - Cup winners to get auto Europa spot |url=http://uk.eurosport.yahoo.com/04102010/58/europa-league-cup-winners-auto-europa-spot.html |publisher=[[Eurosport]] |access-date=25 April 2011}}</ref> [[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]] were the defending champions, but were eliminated by [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] in the quarter-finals, who went on to win the title.

== Third round ==
The draw for the third round was held on 15 September 2011 at 13:00 [[Central European Summer Time|CEST]] at the [[Las Rozas de Madrid|Ciudad del Fútbol de Las Rozas]] in [[Madrid]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.rfef.es/GetDoc?UniqueKeyValue=38382&ShowPath=false&Download=true |title=Round of 32 Draw |publisher=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation|RFEF]] |date=30 August 2011 |access-date=9 September 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110906073050/http://www.rfef.es/GetDoc?UniqueKeyValue=38382&ShowPath=false&Download=true |archive-date=2011-09-06 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

The matches were played on 12 October 2011.

[[Real Oviedo|Oviedo]] received a bye.

== Final phase ==
The draw for the Round of 32 was held on 14 October 2011 at 13:00 [[Central European Summer Time|CEST]] in [[La Ciudad del Fútbol]] in [[Las Rozas de Madrid|Las Rozas]], [[Community of Madrid|Madrid]].<ref name="circular22">{{cite web|url=http://www.rfef.es/GetDoc?UniqueKeyValue=40223&ShowPath=false&Download=true|title=Circular 22|publisher=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation|RFEF]]|language=es|date=10 October 2011|access-date=12 October 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111017140006/http://www.rfef.es/GetDoc?UniqueKeyValue=40223&ShowPath=false&Download=true|archive-date=2011-10-17|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Like previous years, [[Segunda División B]] teams played against the [[La Liga]] teams which qualified for European competitions, this is: four teams from Pot 1 (Segunda B) were drawn against four teams from pot 2a (champions) and the three remaining teams in pot 1 were drawn in the same way with the pot 2b teams (Europa League). The five teams in Pot 3 ([[Segunda División]]) were drawn against five teams of the thirteen remaining teams of La Liga (Pot 4). The remaining eight teams of La Liga faced each other. The lowest ranked teams from each match played at home on the first leg and if two teams from a match played in the same division then the first one to come out of the draw played at home first.<ref name="circular22" />

The first leg was played on 13 December 2011 except for matches involving teams from Pot 2b, which were played on 8 December 2011 (due to [[2011–12 UEFA Europa League group stage|Europa League–Round 6]], except for [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]] which were eliminated from the competition) and the match involving [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] which was played on 9 November 2011 (due to Barcelona's participation at the [[2011 FIFA Club World Cup|FIFA Club World Cup]]). The second leg was played on 22 December 2011.<ref name="circular22" />

==Round of 16==
The draw for Round of 16, Quarterfinals and Semifinals was held on 23 December 2011 at 10:00 [[Central European Time|CET]] in the [[Las Rozas de Madrid|Ciudad del Fútbol de Las Rozas]] in [[Madrid]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.rfef.es/GetDoc?UniqueKeyValue=42602&ShowPath=false&Download=true|title=2011/2012. Circular 29|publisher=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation|RFEF]]|date=2011-12-05|access-date=2011-12-22}}{{Dead link|date=September 2018 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mundodeportivo.com/20111223/copa-del-rey/posible-madrid-barcelona-cuartos-copa-rey_54243286931.html|title=Real Madrid y Barcelona podrían cruzarse en cuartos de final de la Copa|date=2011-12-23|work=mundodeportivo.com}}</ref>

The first leg matches were played on 3, 4 and 5 January while the second legs were played on 10, 11 and 12 January 2012.
